verdict.rationale: BILL's own Spend & Expense marketing says card transactions are automatically categorized, and the docs mention managing transactions, which covers the core idea of coding spend as it happens. The evidence is thin, though: it is marketing-level only. The Invoice Coding Agent and the document attachments apply to AP bills rather than card spend, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented capture of merchant, memo and receipt on each card transaction; detail on how categorization works; independent or hands-on corroboration that this speeds up month-end close.

support.subject: As a finance lead, spend is coded as it happens — merchant, category, memo, receipt — so month-end close is a review, not an archaeology dig

citations.quote: so every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant
